resources.string: Not listening. Tap Start, then play something in another app.
Listening to phone audio. The bar should move when sound plays.
Microphone permission was denied. Android needs it to capture playback audio. Tap Start and allow it.
Screen capture request was cancelled. Tap Start and choose \"Start now\".
Tip: open a YouTube stream, switch back here and watch the bar. If it stays flat while sound is playing, that app may block audio capture.
